title: The Price of Ego
viral_hook_reason: It calls out a hidden psychological defense mechanism (ego protection) that most entrepreneurs feel but never name, creating immediate 'pattern interrupt' curiosity.

scenes.voiceover_text: You keep your prices low because it’s a safety net for your ego.
scenes.visual_prompt_en: Close-up of a person looking thoughtful and slightly frustrated, soft cinematic lighting, high-end office background, 9:16 aspect ratio.

scenes.voiceover_text: Because if they say no, you can tell yourself: 'It wasn't worth much anyway.' It’s a lie that keeps you exhausted.
scenes.visual_prompt_en: Person sitting at a desk, looking at a laptop with a tired expression, rubbing their temples, moody cinematic lighting.

scenes.voiceover_text: Real confidence isn't needing them to buy. It's being perfectly okay even if they don't.
scenes.visual_prompt_en: Person standing up confidently, adjusting their jacket, looking directly into the camera with a calm, steady gaze, blurred city skyline background.

scenes.voiceover_text: Save this for your next pricing call.
scenes.visual_prompt_en: Text overlay graphic on a clean, minimal background with a 'Save this' call-to-action animation.
